events.verdict: Edwards (MIN) places and releases his resting hand from Morant (MEM) as Morant gathers and passes.
Gobert (MIN) places his forearm on Clarke's (MEM) body without extending during Clarke's layup attempt.
Gobert (MIN) collapses his arm when he absorbs the incoming contact from Bane (MEM) as the screen is set.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) jumps alongside Gobert's (MIN) path toward the basket and the contact is initiated by Gobert who slightly extends his off-arm during the driving shot attempt, which is marginal.
Randle (MIN) extends his arm in Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) path and initiates contact to his head at the end of the drive, which affects his SQBR.
Bane (MEM) slides his hand off DiVincenzo (MIN) as DiVincenzo changes direction during the off-ball screen.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) moves alongside Randle's (MIN) path and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Randle before incidental contact occurs.
After Jackson Jr. (MEM) dislodges the ball from Randle (MIN), Gobert (MIN) is in the lane for less than three seconds before his shot attempt.
Morant (MEM) initiates contact with Gobert's (MIN) arm, which affects his shot attempt at the basket.
DiVincenzo (MIN) brings his hand to the ball and maintains it there as he and Jackson Jr. (MEM) both establish control. A jump ball is correctly assessed.
Wells (MEM) establishes a legal guarding position in Edwards's (MIN) path when he firms up and absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Gobert (MIN) maintains verticality while keeping a rested forearm on Morant's (MEM) body, and the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Randle (MIN) as the steal occurs.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Bane (MEM) both lunge toward the loose ball when they come together, causing incidental contact to occur.
DiVincenzo (MIN) moves slightly into Morant's (MEM) path as both players come together during the drive, which is marginal as Morant is able to move through the contact.
The ball is last touched by McDaniels (MIN) prior to it going out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to MEM.
DiVincenzo (MIN) briefly grasps Wells's (MEM) arm before releasing as the screen is set during the inbounds. The contact that occurs is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) moves alongside Morant's (MEM) body and slides his forearm off Morant's body during the upward shooting motion.
Conley (MIN) collapses his arm as he absorbs the incoming contact from Wells (MEM) as the screen is set during the inbounds.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) makes clean contact to the ball after Randle (MIN) recovers the loose ball.
Edwards (MIN) extends his arms and delivers contact to Wells (MEM) that dislodges Wells from his legally obtained defensive position.
Wells (MEM) legally contests Edwards's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Clarke (MEM) is stepping out of bounds when he makes contact with the ball while DiVincenzo (MIN) has control. Possession is correctly awarded to MIN.
Randle (MIN) establishes a screening position when he brushes Morant's (MEM) body when he sets the pick as the contact that occurs is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) releases from Clarke (MEM) without applying any force during his dribble.
Clarke (MEM) legally contests Edwards's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
